freeze_timing_disclosure: The parent analysis protocol fixed the bootstrap count, seed, metrics and H1-H3 questions before modeling. This operational supplement was frozen after test point estimates existed but before any CAS bootstrap interval or SHAP result was computed.

H1.contrast: random internal test minus same frozen model on 2025
H1.bootstrap: independent class-stratified resampling of the two cohorts
H1.across_seed_reporting: point-gap mean, sample SD, minimum and maximum; no five-seed normal-theory significance test

H2.bootstrap: paired class-stratified resampling of shared records within each evaluation group

H3.contrast: random internal test versus same model on 2025
H3.future_sample: 4,887 rows sampled without replacement from 2025, exactly matching that seed's internal-test class counts
H3.class_aggregation: mean absolute SHAP over records and all three output classes
H3.bootstrap: independent class-stratified record resampling of precomputed absolute SHAP contributions
H3.causal_boundary: SHAP is descriptive model attribution, not causal evidence

cross_dataset_boundary: Report direction and uncertainty separately for CAS and STATS19. Do not pool records or absolute metrics and do not claim cross-national generalizability.
